limitations: Matrix used 1-second warmup and 3-second measurement per combination; not sustained-load or soak validation.

JUnit/wall-clock elapsed time is about 32943 seconds while monotonic elapsed time is about 295 seconds. Sleep/suspension or clock changes were not independently established. Do not interpret as a nine-hour soak.
Fault run preceded an added assertion waiting for BatchSpanProcessor thread cleanup; that assertion requires a fresh run.
Initial load fixed pool starts threads lazily; early thread counts are not a stable retention baseline.
Producer allocation excludes exporter, HTTP receiver and other threads.
